name: Jaalam
overview: The Scriptures identify Jaalam as one of the sons of Esau through Aholibamah, his wife, highlighting his place within Esau's lineage in the land of Canaan. Mentioned alongside his brothers Jeush and Korah, Jaalam is recognized as a duke, signifying a leadership role among Esau's descendants. These passages emphasize the historical and genealogical significance of Jaalam within the family of Esau.
